newsitem.title: USA: Bellcore alerts customers about "smart cards".
newsitem.headline: Bellcore alerts customers about "smart cards".

text.p: Bellcore said Thursday it issued an alert to its clients about a potentially serious problem that could impact the security of the "smart cards" used by many domestic and international phone companies and banking institutions.

The company said a smart card can be manipulated into making a computational error which can then render it vulnerable to techniques used by cryptographers to extract secrets stored in the card, including the secret key used to authenticate the legitimacy of that card.

Bellcore, the research arm of the seven regional Bell companies, said it also notified them that Bellcore is available to analyze the various devices and computers that are used by all electronic cash systems to determine the extent of a potential threat to any particular system.
